observation: Fresh main binds granted outcomes to the writer's grant reason, but allowed=true can still coexist with rcl=null. The current writer computes allowed only from a realized runtime transition and then persists the runtime-result envelope, so a grant without that envelope is an impossible writer state.
changes: Require a non-error runtime-result RCL envelope whenever allowed is true.
Publish the same grant/evidence-envelope relation in the v0.1 contract without defining new semantics for nested RCL result fields.
